Track how many times in a row the same type of error has occurred:

- Explicitly state what you tried and why it failed, then switch to a **fundamentally different strategy** (different function family, different decomposition, different JOIN structure).

Before calling submit_result, STOP and explicitly verify each item below. If ANY item fails, run a corrective query FIRST and only then submit.

WITH MovieYears AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(year, LENGTH(year) - 3, 4) AS INTEGER) AS movie_year
  FROM Movie
),
MovieGenders AS (
  SELECT
    m.id AS movie_id,
    a.gender
  FROM Movie m
  JOIN MovieActor ma
    ON m.id = ma.movieId
  JOIN Actor a
    ON ma.actorId = a.id
),
MoviesWithOnlyFemaleActors AS (
  SELECT
    movie_id
  FROM MovieGenders
  GROUP BY
    movie_id
  HAVING
    COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = 'Female' THEN 1 END) > 0 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = 'Male' THEN 1 END) = 0 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN gender IS NULL OR gender = 'None' THEN 1 END) = 0
)
SELECT
  my.movie_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT my.id) AS total_movies,
  100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT fof.movie_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT my.id) AS percentage_female_only
FROM MovieYears my
LEFT JOIN MoviesWithOnlyFemaleActors fof
  ON my.id = fof.movie_id
GROUP BY
  my.movie_year
ORDER BY
  my.movie_year;
